audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree and match the packet chart: Ambessa 1-3, Skill at 4-5, Master Yi from 6 onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown anywhere in the content layer's spikes; the level 6 spike names neither timer.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s and Highlander is a flat 85s — that gap is the whole reason level 6 flips to you. Repudiation is 18s at rank 1, Cunning Sweep 14s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has her slots swapped. It calls Repudiation her E and describes E as a stun with damage reduction. Repudiation is her W: a shield plus a braced slam that deals increased damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing — no stun, no damage reduction. Her E is Lacerate, a whip that damages and slows, with a second strike if she initiates Drakehound's Step from it. Nothing on the page says Public Execution breaks Meditate.
audit.why: A player baiting a stun that does not exist mistimes every trade, and Meditate is a channel — the R suppression and stun cancel it outright.
audit.corrected: W Repudiation (18/17/16/15/14s) = shield + braced slam + grounding. E Lacerate (13/12/11/10/9s) = damage + slow. R Public Execution (130/115/100s) = blink, suppress, stun, and it ends any Meditate channel. Drakehound's Step (P) is the dash-and-empowered-attack tell that opens her combo.

audit.why: Her two punishable cooldowns are W at 18s and R at 130s at rank 1.

edits.before: Ambessa dominates early with her dash-heavy Q and W chain and her E (Repudiation) that reduces incoming damage and stuns if she's hit during it. Trading into her combo just feeds her, so farm safe and never walk into her double-dash range without her cooldowns down.
edits.after: Ambessa dominates early with Cunning Sweep (Q, 14s) into its Sundering Slam recast, and Repudiation (W, 18s) shields her and hits harder if she blocked damage while bracing. Trading into that just feeds her — farm safe and never step into Drakehound's Step range with her cooldowns up.

edits.before: Your Highlander flips the tempo. Her R (Public Execution) is a long dash-grab, but your Q Alpha Strike untargetable dash can dodge her follow-up combos, so this is where you start to contest even fights.
edits.after: Your Highlander (85s) flips the tempo. Public Execution (R, 130s at rank 1) blinks, suppresses and stuns — it also breaks Meditate outright, so never channel while it is up. Alpha Strike dodges the follow-up.

edits.before: With Wuju Style plus Berserker's, your true damage on-hits out-DPS her in a stuck fight. Bait her E damage-reduction window, then commit once it's down and burn her through Meditate.
edits.after: With Wuju Style plus Berserker's, your true damage on-hits out-DPS her in a stuck fight. Bait Repudiation (W, 18s) — it is the shield, not her E — then commit once it is spent and grind her down.

edits.before: Level 3 gives her the full E stun-and-combo you can't punish yet.
edits.after: Level 3 gives her Lacerate's slow into a Q combo you can't punish.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Ambessa's: her dashes and E stun-on-hit let her open combos you can't answer without E points, so last-hit at range.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Ambessa's: her passive dash and Lacerate's slow open combos you can't answer without Wuju Style, so last-hit at range.

edits.before: After your first item true damage and Highlander resets out-DPS her mobility — dodge her R engage with Q and shred her once her E window is spent.
edits.after: After your first item true damage and Highlander resets out-DPS her mobility — dodge her R blink with Alpha Strike and shred her once Repudiation is spent.

edits.before: Use Q Alpha Strike to dodge her E stun window and R combo
edits.after: Use Alpha Strike to dodge her R blink and the Q recast

edits.before: Land her Q-W dash chain plus E stun for a full combo
edits.after: Land Q into Sundering Slam with W's empowered slam

edits.before: Use E's damage reduction to win drawn-out early trades
edits.after: Use W's shield and brace to win drawn-out early trades

edits.before: Track her W cooldown above all — it's her main damage and the core of her chain-CC combo. When her W and her dash are down she has no kill threat, and that's your window to step up and trade or all-in.
edits.after: Track Repudiation (W, 18s at rank 1) — it shields her and hits harder if she braced your damage. Public Execution (R) is 130s at rank 1; once it and her dash are down she has no kill threat, and that is your window.

notes: The content layer had Ambessa's W and E swapped throughout and invented a stun plus damage reduction on the wrong slot; all of that is corrected here. One thing deliberately NOT written to the page: the missing-interactions file says Ambessa 'sustains through chip damage (Public Execution)' and the kit carries a heal flag on R, but Riot's R description contains no heal at all — per the derived-flag rule the description wins, so no anti-heal advice was added for her. If she does in fact heal off R, the anti-heal line should be added to late.
